description: Permanently delete a form and every submission it received. There is no trash and no undo. A form that no longer exists is not deleted again - the call reports that nothing matched. To stop new submissions but keep the existing ones, set the form's status to archived with update_form - only a published form accepts submissions. To remove a single submission, use delete_form_submission. Returns { deleted }.

idOrSlug.description: The form's id or slug to delete
